summary: Implemented BACKUP-1: strict `.ndcase` manifest, one-case fflate exporter with recomputed SHA-256 and safe image paths, File System Access plus download save paths, and 23 real-archive tests; targeted test, typecheck, full suite, lint, format, build, and coverage pass.

payload.agentOutputExcerpt: Implemented BACKUP-1: strict `.ndcase` manifest, one-case fflate exporter with recomputed SHA-256 and safe image paths, File System Access plus download save paths, and 23 real-archive tests; targeted test, typecheck, full suite, lint, format, build, and coverage pass.
decisions: The manifest reuses the strict domain case/card/connection schemas so tags, positions, viewport, closure, OCR, crop/rotation, isDemo, and backupPromptedAt round-trip without a parallel model.
Attachment paths are derived only from UUID plus MIME type (`images/<id>.<ext>`), so titles and tags can never become ZIP paths.
Export recomputes every SHA-256 from Blob bytes instead of trusting the stored digest; image entries are stored uncompressed while the manifest is deflated.
ZIP entry mtimes are set from `exportedAt`, making repeated exports of the same case at the same injected time byte-stable.
The repository gained `listConnections(caseId)` because export needs validated connection reads and no connection repository exists yet.
agentReportedTests: npm run test:coverage: exit 0 (src/domain 96.79% lines, src/data 94.61% lines, src/features/backup 87.3% lines)
warnings: `listConnections` is a new shared-file API on `src/data/caseRepository.ts`; future owners must preserve validated reads and pairKey ordering.
The native save picker is opened after hashing in `exportCase`, so transient user activation can expire for very large archives; BACKUP-3 may need a pre-opened destination for such cases.
`DEFAULT_APP_VERSION` is hardcoded to 0.1.0 and should be replaced by build-time version injection if the package version changes.
`docs/EXECUTION-AUDIT.jsonl` has a pre-existing engine-generated modification that was not authored or touched.
validationLimitations: Tests run under Node with fake-indexeddb because jsdom Blobs are not structurally cloneable by fake-indexeddb.
No real-browser File System Access or download behavior was exercised; BACKUP-4 owns that journey.
payload.taskDescription: Create archiveFormat.ts with a Zod-validated manifest for format notes-detective-case, formatVersion 1, exportedAt, appVersion, dbSchemaVersion, the case record, cards, connections, and attachment metadata with SHA-256 and relative image paths. The case record includes isDemo and backupPromptedAt. Create exportCase.ts to load exactly one case and its attachments, hash each Blob, and build a ZIP with manifest.json plus images/<attachmentId>.<ext> using fflate. Include tags, positions, viewport, closure state, OCR fields, and the demo marker. Expose save via File System Access when available and a Blob download fallback. Add tests that unzip the result, validate the manifest, verify checksums, and prove no other case is included.
